name: Tool: build the Example Mod arena world (C#)
author: test
summary: Builds the arena of ExampleWorldFileSubworld with Example Mod blocks and walls, saves it and logs where the file is.
description: Compile with tools/tests/build-cs.sh cswldmake and run with SAMPLE=1. Copy Worlds/<main world id>/CsWldMake_ArenaMaker.subworld and its .bl files to samples/ExampleModCSharp/Content/Subworlds/ExampleArena.wld.
